sample_unit: LLM responses (200 microbiology MCQs x 7 models x 3 sessions)

links.outcome: Test-retest reliability (ICC) of LLM answers across three repeated sessions
links.effect: Claude ICC 0.966 (excellent) vs Gemini ICC 0.290 (poor); session-to-session fluctuations of up to 100 percentage points on individual topics.
links.quote: Test-retest reliability varied dramatically: Claude achieved excellent ICC (0.966), while Gemini exhibited poor reliability (ICC = 0.290), with session-to-session fluctuations of up to 100 percentage points on individual topics.

screen.reason: Evaluates accuracy and test-retest reliability of seven LLMs on medical microbiology exam questions across cognitive levels, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
